nom: Torriden DIVE IN Hyaluronic Acid Serum for Deep Hydration

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum is suitable for their skin type, absorbing quickly without feeling sticky, greasy, or heavy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with severe post-menopausal dryness, report strong and comfortable hydration that lasts, though one reviewer with very dry skin found the hydration insufficient on its own and needed to layer a heavier moisturizer on top.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the serum controls excess oil in oilier areas while calming tightness and irritation elsewhere, without triggering breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, several of whom also mention rosacea, report the serum soothes their skin with no stinging, redness, or irritation, including tolerance alongside tretinoin or isotretinoin use.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature report lasting hydration that leaves fine lines and wrinkles looking softer and less pronounced, without irritation.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers connect the serum's hydration with a softer, less visible look to fine lines and wrinkles, including around the eyes and on the forehead, though this reads as a temporary plumping effect from hydration rather than a lasting structural change.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers across skin types report a marked increase in hydration and plumper, more comfortable skin, with some describing the effect as lasting through the day; one reviewer with very dry skin found the hydration underwhelming compared to marketing claims and needed to layer a heavier moisturizer on top.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report reduced redness, including under-eye redness attributed to a medication and redness on sensitive skin around the nose.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer using tretinoin or isotretinoin reports the serum keeps her skin barrier moisturized and plump without added irritation; another describes the hyaluronic acid as reinforcing the skin's barrier as part of its hydrating effect.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including some who are acne-prone or using accutane, report no new breakouts and calmer skin; one reviewer describes painful, cystic-type pimples developing under the chin that she blames on the serum and says it disrupted her progress clearing her skin.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the serum absorbs quickly and leaves no greasy or sticky residue.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup and skincare
Good value, a little goes a long way
Occasional batch inconsistency, cloudy or irritating

extraits.texte: I’m 52 with post-menopausal mature dry skin, and hydration is non-negotiable for me. If a serum doesn’t genuinely hydrate, my skin shows it immediately—tightness, dullness, fine lines looking deeper, and makeup clinging where it shouldn’t. I’ve tried a lot of hyaluronic acid serums over the years, and many either sit on the skin or feel great for five minutes and then vanish. Torriden Dive-In is different. I can feel the difference by mid-day, which is when most hyaluronic acid serums fail me. The texture is lightweight but not watery or flimsy. It has a smooth, fluid consistency that spreads easily and evenly without dragging on the skin, and a little goes a long way. It absorbs quickly but doesn’t disappear on contact—my skin actually feels hydrated, not just temporarily damp. What really stands out for me is that the hydration lasts. My skin stays comfortable, plump, and supple for hours, not minutes. Fine lines look softer simply because my skin is properly hydrated, and that tight, dry feeling never comes back during the day. Despite delivering real moisture, it feels weightless and never sticky or tacky. I can layer it with other serums, moisturizer, and sunscreen with no pilling, and it works beautifully under makeup. I’ve had zero irritation with this serum—no stinging, redness, or sensitivity—which is important for mature, dryness-prone skin that can easily react. I've only been using it for 2 weeks, but I appreciate the hydration & it's not sticky like other HA's I've used. I have rosacea/sensitive skin & this soothes my skin when it feels especially dry & angry. Hyaluronic acid works on your face by acting as a powerful humectant, attracting & holding water molecules to the skin's surface to provide deep hydration & a plumping effect. This process helps to smooth the skin's texture, reduce the appearance of fine lines & wrinkles, & strengthen the skin's natural barrier. Hyaluronic acid (HA) acts like a magnet, drawing water from the environment & the deeper layers of the skin to the surface. Because of this, make sure to use on damp skin. I use an essence, but even water left over from washing your face will work. Use a thicker moisturizer or facial oil to lock in the moisture & keep the water from escaping. I'm able to use this in the morning or at night. I think this is suitable for all skin types, including oily. It's not sticky, greasy or heavy. Very lightweight & hydrating. This was also a lot of product that'll last me for a while. I appreciate the glass bottle being refillable & saving a bit by buying the refill.

Ich bin sehr begeistert von diesem Serum. Ich habe es vor ein paar Wochen bestellt, nachdem ich viele positive Bewertungen gelesen hatte. Ich habe eine Mischhaut, die aber oft spannt und gereizt ist. Ich habe schon viele Produkte ausprobiert, aber keines hat mir so gut geholfen wie dieses Serum. Das Serum ist sehr leicht und flüssig. Es lässt sich leicht auftragen und verteilen. Es zieht schnell ein und hinterlässt kein klebriges oder öliges Gefühl. Es hat keinen Duft und keine künstlichen Farben, was ich sehr schätze. Es ist auch vegan und tierversuchsfrei, was mir wichtig ist. Das Serum spendet meiner Haut sofort, tief und lang anhaltend Feuchtigkeit. Es enthält fünf Arten von Hyaluronsäure, die in verschiedenen Hautschichten wirken und die Haut praller und glatter machen. Ich merke sofort, wie meine Haut erfrischt und hydratisiert wird. Ich habe auch das Gefühl, dass meine Haut strahlender und elastischer geworden ist. Das Serum beruhigt auch meine empfindliche Nasenhaut und lindert Irritationen. Es enthält D-Panthenol, Allantoin und Madecassoside, die entzündungshemmenden und wundheilenden Eigenschaften haben. Meine Haut fühlt sich viel ruhiger und geschmeidiger an. Ich habe keine Rötungen oder Schuppungen mehr. Ich benutze das Serum jeden Tag morgens und abends nach der Reinigung und dem Toner. Ich trage ein paar Tropfen auf mein Gesicht auf und klopfe es sanft ein. Ich benutze es unter meiner Tages- oder Nachtcreme. Es passt gut zu anderen Produkten und unter dem Makeup

I’ve been using the Torriden DIVE IN Hyaluronic Acid Serum for a while now, and it’s an okay product, but not amazing. The serum has a lightweight, watery texture that absorbs quickly and provides decent hydration without feeling sticky or heavy. It does help with basic moisture and works well under makeup, but I didn’t notice a significant improvement in glow or long-lasting hydration as advertised. For very dry skin, the hydration may not be enough on its own and needs to be layered with a heavier moisturizer. The ingredients are gentle and didn’t irritate my skin, which is a plus. However, considering the price (even as a pack of two), the results feel fairly average. Overall, it’s a safe and mild serum, but nothing particularly standout compared to other hyaluronic acid serums on the market.
